# Third-party code in avr-rtclib-ds1307.ino.hex

The firmware image is the sketch next to it linked with the libraries below,
as the compile service builds it. They are redistributed here in binary form
under their own licences.

| Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| RTClib | 2.1.4 | MIT |
| Adafruit BusIO | 1.17.4 | MIT |
| Arduino AVR core and Wire | as installed by the compile service | LGPL 2.1 or later |

Built on 30 September 2026 at 00:21:57 UTC, which is what `__DATE__` and
`__TIME__` are in this image (`Sep 30 2026`, `00:21:57`). A rebuild changes
them, and the tests that name them with it.
